title: Add Watch-page comments and remove Viewer Timer completely

requirements.text: Remove the Viewer Timer feature entirely from the Watch page UI so no timer controls, timer sidebar, or timer-related text are shown on mobile or desktop.

quotes: So add comments and what i said earlier but no timer

acceptanceCriteria: When viewing any media on the Watch page, there is no Viewer Timer card, no timer inputs/buttons, and no 'Viewer Timer' label anywhere in the rendered UI.
The Watch page still plays media normally and shows title/date/duration metadata without errors.
There is no timer-related logic executed from WatchPage (e.g., no onTimerEnd/pause callback wiring from a timer component).

requirements.text: Implement backend comment storage and APIs so comments can be created and fetched per media item (keyed by the Watch page media title). Include comment text, author principal, and createdAt timestamp in the stored record, and return comments in reverse-chronological order (newest first).

quotes: So add comments and what i said earlier but no timer

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method to fetch comments for a given media title and returns an empty list when there are no comments.
Backend exposes an authenticated method to add a comment for a given media title; unauthenticated callers are rejected consistently with existing access-control behavior.
Each returned comment includes: text, author (Principal), and createdAt (Time).

requirements.text: Add React Query hooks to fetch and post comments via the backend actor, and ensure caches update immediately after posting (invalidate/refetch the relevant comments query for that media title).

quotes: So add comments and what i said earlier but no timer

acceptanceCriteria: A Watch-page comments query is keyed by media title (e.g., ['comments', title]) and refetches when the title changes.
Posting a comment triggers an update so the new comment appears without requiring a manual page refresh.
If the backend actor is unavailable, the comments UI shows a clear English error message instead of failing silently.

requirements.text: Add a comments section under the media on the Watch page that (a) lists existing comments and (b) allows signed-in users to post a new comment. Guests can read comments but must sign in to post (show an English sign-in prompt and disable/hide the submit action for guests).

quotes: So add comments and what i said earlier but no timer

acceptanceCriteria: The Watch page shows a 'Comments' section beneath the video player/metadata area.
If there are no comments, the UI displays an English empty state such as 'No comments yet. Be the first to comment.'
Signed-in users see a text input (textarea) and a 'Post comment' button; submitting posts the comment and clears the input on success.
Guests can see the comment list (and empty state), but cannot post; the UI shows an English message such as 'Sign in to post a comment.'
Posted comments render with their text and a readable timestamp; author display uses the commenter profile name when available, otherwise a safe fallback label in English.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.

Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui; compose existing components instead.
Use English for all user-facing UI text related to comments and any error/empty states.
nonGoals: Threaded replies, @mentions, comment likes/reactions, or moderation tooling.
Real-time comments (no WebSockets); standard fetch/refetch behavior via React Query only.
